import cv2
import numpy as np

img16 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0016.png')
# check colors at x in [0, 40], y in [400, 511]
for y in range(400, 510, 20):
    for x in range(0, 30, 5):
        print(f"16 ({x},{y}): {img16[y, x].tolist()}")

img14 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0014.png')
hsv14 = cv2.cvtColor(img14, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
couch_mask14 = cv2.inRange(hsv14, (100, 20, 50), (130, 150, 200))
ys, xs = np.where(couch_mask14)
print(f"Couch 14: u in [{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], v in [{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}]")

img19 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0019.png')
# chair 2:
chair_mask19 = (img19[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img19[:, :, 2] < 170) & (img19[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img19[:, :, 1] < 100) & (img19[:, :, 0] < 60)
chair2_mask19 = np.zeros_like(chair_mask19)
chair2_mask19[:, 350:] = chair_mask19[:, 350:]
ys, xs = np.where(chair2_mask19)
print(f"Chair 2 in 19: u in [{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], v in [{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}]")
